description: This Kotlin source file defines an object 'NotesSyncScheduler' that encapsulates scheduling of background synchronization tasks for notes. It provides methods to schedule periodic syncs and enqueue one-off syncs using Android's WorkManager with network constraints.

classes.name: NotesSyncScheduler
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to schedule and enqueue background sync tasks with network constraints using WorkManager.

methods.name: schedulePeriodic
methods.description: Schedules a periodic sync job to run every 6 hours, constrained to run only when the network is connected. Intended to be called once during application startup.

methods.name: enqueueOneOff
methods.description: Enqueues a one-time sync job that runs immediately with a network connected constraint. Useful for manual sync actions.
